basis.label: Bridges (other than block, brick, concrete and stone)
basis.note: Printed page 45. Covers steel and timber bridges. Buildings and structures category. Printed DV 4%, SL 3%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
